what: FROZEN predictions for E83, made before the #community-lab claim and before any E83 launch: the burst and sustained clock under the card's own governor of the 33 kinds of kinds.json that E80 did not run, plus E80's five anchors repeated inside the session

relation.form: dither at an effective cap W, W ~ Normal(W*, sigma), on P_f = B_f + c s_f
relation.fitted_on: E80's 18 kinds only: measured c (results.json cells.*.c_w), burst = A1's burst_mhz_without (posthoc-idle.json kinds.*), sustained = cells.*.sus_mhz

fp32/zeros.rule: every element +0.0 (0x00000000): every lane gated on an accumulate pass

fp32/neg_ones.rule: every element -1.0 (0xBF800000): `ones` with the sign bit set

fp32/randn_small.rule: normal, sigma 2^-10: the same mantissas, an exponent band 10 lower

fp32/randn_large.rule: normal, sigma 2^10: the same mantissas, an exponent band 10 higher

fp32/uniform01.rule: uniform [0, 1): sign always 0, exponent always below 127

fp32/sparse50.rule: randn with half the elements (= words, E=1) set to +0.0

fp32/pow2.rule: 2^(U{0..16} - 8), the host's `pow2`: mantissa 0, exponent random, sign 0

fp32/fp16grid.rule: randn rounded to the nearest fp16 value: the low 13 mantissa bits zeroed

fp32/a_randn_b_zeros.rule: A randn, B all +0.0: every accumulate lane gated by the B side

fp32/a_zeros_b_randn.rule: A all +0.0, B randn: gated by the A side, which is the broadcast one

fp32/randn_sorted.rule: `randn`'s own 512 words, permuted into the unit's stream order of least change

fp16/randn.rule: standard normal, sigma 1, rounded to fp16

fp16/randn_small.rule: normal, sigma 2^-6, rounded to fp16: fp16's exponent range is only 5 bits

fp16/sparse90.rule: randn with 90% of the elements zero: 81% of the words gate

fp16/wsparse50.rule: randn with half the WORDS zero: the kind that really gates half of fp16's lanes

fp16/wsparse90.rule: randn with 90% of the words zero

fp16/a_zeros_b_randn.rule: A all zero, B randn: the other orientation, the broadcast side gated

fp16/pair_half_zero.rule: in every (a1, a2) pair exactly one half is zero: the word never gates, but PRM 9.4's two-term update is dropped on every one of the 4,096 updates

fp16/randn_sorted.rule: `randn`'s own words, permuted into the stream order of least change

int8/full.rule: uniform over -128..127, the whole two's-complement range (E64's int8 `randn`)

int8/pos.rule: uniform over 0..127, sign bit always 0 (E64's int8 `uniform`)

int8/ternary.rule: -1, 0, +1 with equal probability: a ternary-quantised weight

int8/sparse90.rule: `full` with 90% of the bytes zero: 65.6% of the words gate

int8/wsparse50.rule: `full` with half the WORDS zero: still gates only ~5/8 of int8's lanes, because the gate wants BOTH words of the column pair

int8/highbit.rule: +64 or -64 (0x40 / 0xC0): one magnitude bit, the sign changing

int8/a_zeros_b_full.rule: A all zero, B uniform -128..127: the broadcast side gated instead

int8/sorted.rule: `full`'s own words, permuted into the stream order of least change
